card.name: Start of nelfinavir in drug lists
card.fires_on: The first letter "n" or "N" of nelfinavir when it appears in a list of HIV protease inhibitors or interacting drugs. It also fires on the start of similar n-drug names such as norethindrone in lists.

modes.label: Nelfinavir in inhibitor lists
modes.description: The initial "n" of nelfinavir after a comma in a list of CYP3A4 inhibitors or antiretrovirals.
modes.example: The use of potent CYP 3A4 inhibitors (ritonavir,<< n>>elfinavir, indinav

modes.label: Nelfinavir as a list heading
modes.description: Capital "N" starting nelfinavir right after the atazanavir dosing entry in an interaction table.
modes.example: See prescribing information for atazanavir for dosing information.<< N>>elfinavir: Avoid concom

card.writes: It seems to push the model to finish the name nelfinavir ("elfinavir"), though the listed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It spots the first letter of nelfinavir in a list of interacting HIV drugs, so the model can complete the name.
